description: Aggregator dashboard of compute-infra compliance for the canonical-derivation chain. Joins four upstream audit witnesses into one current-state snapshot. See docs/audits/2026-05-12-canonical-derivation-compute-review.md §3 for the contract definitions.

contracts.name: WitnessBuilder usage (P30)
contracts.metric: 96 of 405 files write witnesses without WitnessBuilder
contracts.remediation: Batch-port hand-written .witness.json writers to witness_base.WitnessBuilder. Reference: docs/audits/2026-05-08-compute-audit-workplan.md §Tier 2.

contracts.name: CODATA constants from registry only (P31)
contracts.metric: 40 hardcoded CODATA literals outside the allowlist
contracts.remediation: Replace each hit with import from codata_constants (_VALIDATION aliases) or experimental_constants. Tag audit-only consumers with `# noqa: P31` and a justifying comment.

contracts.name: 3-input canonical scheme (CAL-1/2/3)
contracts.remediation: Migrate over-count scripts (consume both m_p and m_n) to the 3-input scheme: m_n = m_p + Q_β + m_e, with m_p derived from |tr_M(p, q_0)| · E_0. Reference: docs/audits/2026-05-10-workplan-0b-script-rewire-handoff.md.

contracts.name: Per-chain trust-basis validation
contracts.remediation: Read derivation-chain-audit.witness.json `assertions` for failed chain IDs and trust-basis transitions. Each `script_cited` step that fails should be promoted to `derived` or `lean_proven`.

contracts.name: CAL-3 ↔ CODATA cross-check
contracts.remediation: Refresh codata_constants.py against CODATA 2022 and re-run codata_reconciliation.py.

contracts.name: Witness reproducibility (P32)
contracts.remediation: For drift: investigate non-determinism (PYTHONHASHSEED, timestamps, hand-edits to committed JSON not reproduced by the script). For error/timeout: install missing deps or bump PER_BUILDER_TIMEOUT_S. Reference: witness_reproducibility_check.py + docs/audits/2026-05-12-canonical-derivation-compute-review.md §4 P3.2.

known_open_conflicts.summary: Registry TR_M_AT_Q0 (Wenzl-bridge y_λ assembly) disagrees with Frobenius-selected τ_M (`from_scratch/` chain on commit 25a204efa). Two distinct canonical values for the same nominal quantity.

closed_recently: P3.2 — witness reproducibility byte-equality check (P32 contract above)

recommended_next.summary: Migrate the 40 P31 hits (hardcoded CODATA literals) to codata_constants validation aliases. Mechanical, one file at a time. Suggested batch order: highest-import files first (e.g. derivation_chain.py, experimental_constants consumers).

Port the 96 hand-written .witness.json writers to witness_base.WitnessBuilder. Some hand-written witnesses encode review-only metadata that needs a builder pattern extension; case-by-case judgement required.
Rename schur-weyl-weight-* → tau-sw-weight-* across 21 derivation-JSONs + 8 Python consumers.

112 over-count scripts to migrate to the 3-input scheme (derive m_n = m_p + Q_β instead of importing both). Largest-scope semantic change; needs per-script verification that downstream consumers still round-trip.

caveats: Aggregator-only: this script does NOT re-run any of the four source audits. Stale source witnesses propagate stale results here. Each source's `computedAt` is preserved in `source_summaries` so reviewers can spot staleness directly.
Contract thresholds are heuristic (e.g. P30>50 = fail). They reflect 2026-05-12 baseline; tighten as the infra-discipline backlog drains.
